steps.objective: Read plans/260905-architecture-advisory-panel/phase-01-advisory-soul-and-manual-proof.md in full first (P01.1 section, Soul Deliverables, Required Doctrine -- these ARE the spec, not a paraphrase). Also read docs/architect/agent-coordination/playbooks/prompts/master-coordinator.md in full as the proven structural reference this new playbook must be 'analogous in usability to' -- same one-entry-prompt usability bar, but for consulting/design instead of implementation cells. Also read plans/260905-architecture-advisory-panel/plan.md's 'Read This First - Trong Mem Ngoai Cung' section: the single most important failure to avoid is building an impressive harness that cannot advise well; no artifact you write may move empathy, materiality judgment, reframing, alternative quality, debate style, recommendation calibration, or explanation into a kernel-enum-shaped list -- write real judgment prose, not schema pretending to be judgment. Then create exactly these 4 files: (1) docs/architect/agent-coordination/playbooks/prompts/architecture-advisory-coordinator.md -- a self-contained coordinator prompt (paste-into-one-session usability, matching master-coordinator.md's own Usage/Runtime-Boundary framing) covering: input block, document/decision authority order, a scout-before-ask rule (investigate before asking a person anything), role routing (how the coordinator selects executor/tier/persona per actor from a proven-safe roster and records derived provider/model), a nine-phase cognitive loop encoding phase-01.md's 8 Required Doctrine principles (Understand the person, Understand the problem, Ask reluctantly but clearly, Diverge honestly, Debate claims, Converge without flattening, Explain for ownership, Stay in dialogue -- pick a coherent 9th phase, e.g. an explicit intake/framing phase before 'Understand the person', or split one of the 8 into two real phases; justify the split in the doc itself), persistence and crash-recovery (a fresh coordinator must be able to resume from persisted artifacts alone, with zero chat history), the Decision Dialogue protocol (person's immutable words vs lead-advisor interpretation vs driver authorization vs panel response kept as separate, never-merged artifacts), explicit bounds (Work stays read-only/optional context, no git/merge/approve authority, no anonymization, no vote tallying), and stop conditions. (2) docs/architect/agent-coordination/playbooks/architecture-advisory-role-doctrine.md -- full doctrine for EVERY role phase-01.md names (lead advisor, context investigator, system shaper, alternative shaper, constraint advocate, architecture critic, synthesizer, independent red-team, specialist): each role needs purpose, posture, what to notice, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns, handoff shape, AND at least one concrete good example and one concrete bad example of that role's own output -- a role name plus a list of expected-output fields is explicitly insufficient per phase-01.md and will be rejected by Reviewer/Red-Team. Also include driver-disposition doctrine (accepted/answered/mitigated/deferred/unresolved/invalidated-by-evidence, including when the driver must NOT disposition without another advisor's evidence) and a role-routing roster showing how tier/persona/executor selection actually happens per actor. (3) docs/architect/agent-coordination/playbooks/architecture-advisory-artifact-templates.md -- prose templates for every artifact the coordinator prompt and role doctrine reference (e.g. a DecisionRequest, a candidate architecture proposal, a critique/attack record, a DialogueImpactAssessment, a final Decision Packet) written to help a real advisor reason well, never schema-only placeholders. (4) docs/architect/agent-coordination/playbooks/architecture-advisory-evaluation-rubric.md -- the qualitative rubric from phase-01.md's own 'Evaluation Rubric' section (understanding improved beyond initial wording, questions necessary/consolidated/explained, alternatives materially different and credible, evidence contradicted as well as supported early hypotheses, advisors could change their minds and explain why, dissent survived synthesis, recommendation decisive but calibrated, explanation enabled ownership, a fresh coordinator could resume from artifacts alone, provider/model diversity improved independence not just decoration, every shaper states falsification criteria before critics see the proposal, the person's own rubric assessment recorded before Reviewer/Red-Team see it and the evaluator is never the session driver). Stay strictly inside the panel-soul lease -- these 4 files plus this cell's own verification report/trace under docs/architect/agent-coordination/verification/architecture-advisory-panel/{P01.1.md,proofs/P01.1/**} and plans/260905-architecture-advisory-panel/reports/**. Do NOT touch production skills, protocol definitions, runtime, schemas, contracts, CLI, pack registry, or canonical specs -- this phase is prose-only per its own Files section. Write real, load-bearing prose across all 4 files (they will very likely run long -- master-coordinator.md itself is 571 lines; treat that as a floor for genuine doctrine depth, not a ceiling to undercut). Record git status --short and commit your work on this cell's own worktree branch when done.
